name: Shenghe Resources Holding Co., Ltd
summary: Shenghe Resources Holding Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and application of rare earth and related products. The company offers rare earth products, such as rare earth concentrates, compounds, oxides, and metals. It also offers mineral sands comprising zircon sands, titanium concentrate, rutile, kyanite, garnet and monazite, etc. The company's products are used in new energy vehicles, wind power generation, energy saving motors, low carbon emission reduction, precision casting, aerospace, refectory materials, and petrochemicals. It serves new energy, new materials, energy conservation and environmental protection, aerospace, military, and electronic information…
